text: The need of mutual aid and support which had lately taken refuge in the narrow circle of the family, or the slum neighbours, in the village, or the secret union of workers, re-asserts itself again, even in our modern society, and claims its rights to be, as it always has been, the chief leader towards further progress.
author: Peter Kropotkin
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter VIII, Mutual Aid Amongst Ourselves (continued)
